title: My marketer has to show its work.
hook: Six questions every marketer should answer, from evidence, every time.
thesis: Agencies sell hype and vanity metrics, and AI copywriters sell confident prose nobody can verify. FYD's marketer must answer six questions from evidence: what did you do, why, what evidence did you use, who authorized it, what happened, what did you learn. This post is the anti-agency pitch in plain language, aimed at owners who have been burned by marketing reports full of vibes.

verified: FYD's marketer must answer the six accountability questions from evidence every time (FYD ten-day directive, via SYSTEMS.md section 2).
inferred: Framing it as show-your-work will resonate with owners burned by vanity metrics.
